subject: Intro: Hosted API quick eval — Marketly
messages:
From: Sofia Ramos <sofia@marketly.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@marketly.com>
Date: 2028-03-14T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick hosted-api eval request — Marketly

Hi Grace / Diego,

We just spun up a sandbox on Redwood and I wanted to request a short walkthrough/demo for our data science + infra team. We are evaluating the Hosted API for an embedding + reranking flow and would like to move quickly — two people on our side (Tom & me).

Preferred times: mornings PT next week (between 9:00–12:00 PT). 30 min is fine for the initial session; if it looks promising we can book a deeper technical follow-up.

A couple quick notes about our environment: Marketly runs mostly on GCP (us-west1), we already have an initial token and a small test workload in the sandbox. If you can share an agenda and any pre-read that would help Tom prepare.

Thanks — Sofia
Sofia Ramos
Senior ML Engineer | Marketly Inc.
sofia@marketly.com

[No attachments]
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia@marketly.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-15T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick hosted-api eval request — Marketly

Hi Sofia — great to meet you and welcome to Redwood. Glad you found the sandbox.

I can do a compact 30-minute walkthrough that covers:
- quick product orientation (hosted API surface)
- sandbox verification (tokens, CORS, region)
- a short live demo for embeddings + reranking with your sample scenario

Slots I have next week (PT):
- Tue 2028-03-20 11:30am–12:00pm PT
- Wed 2028-03-21 9:00am–9:30am PT
- Wed 2028-03-21 11:00am–11:30am PT

If you'd like a deeper technical session (45–60 min) we can add Ben (solutions engineer) and a demo environment review. For the compact session, please include the two folks who will attend and any specific prompt/examples you want us to run.

Quick agenda attached and a short sandbox preflight note — please review before the call.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior SDR Manager, Redwood Inference
grace@redwood.com

[Attachment: quick-agenda.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: sandbox-invite.txt (text)]

Subject: Re: Quick hosted-api eval request — Marketly

Thanks Grace — Wed the 21st at 9:00am PT works best for us (Tom and I).

Two quick asks: can you (1) confirm the expected runtime for a short embeddings + rerank sample (we expect the tokens to be small, <200 tokens per request), and (2) include any minimal preflight steps so we can validate before the call?

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-15T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick hosted-api eval request — Marketly

Hi Sofia — happy to coordinate. I can lock in Wed 2028-03-21 9:00–9:30am PT. Ben, can you join as a solutions engineer for a quick live run-through? If Ben is tied up we can start with the compact session and schedule a 45 min follow-up with him.

Sofia — answers inline to your asks:
1) Runtime: for small embedding requests (<200 tokens) you should expect sub-200ms p99 on our hosted endpoints for the model we typically demo; for reranking samples it will vary with candidate set size but the compact demo will show realistic figures.
2) Preflight: the sandbox-invite.txt Grace attached includes the minimal curl examples and a sample request body. I'll also drop basic sandbox creds after booking as an attachment stub here.

I will send a calendar invite for Wed 2028-03-21 9:00am PT to all attendees and paste the sandbox creds in the invite notes.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
SDR — Redwood Inference
diego@redwood.com
